settings.heading: We'd Love to Hear From You
settings.text: Questions about an order, a recipe, or a wholesale partnership? Send us a message and our team will reply within one business day.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days and arrive within 3-7 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: Do you offer wholesale pricing?
settings.answer: Yes — select "Wholesale inquiry" in the contact form above and our team will follow up with pricing and minimums.
